description: This is a test class for the HiveMqtt5ClientActor, part of the MQTT connectivity services using HiveMQ client within the Eclipse Ditto project. The file contains unit tests for client connection handling, subscription failure, message publishing, and actor behavior.

classes.name: HiveMqtt5ClientActorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for the HiveMqtt5ClientActor, testing connection behaviors, message handling, and failure scenarios within MQTT connectivity.

methods.name: initClient
methods.description: Initializes the MQTT client before each test, mocks the MQTT5Client, and sets up the factory.

methods.name: expectDisconnectCalled
methods.description: Asserts that a disconnect has been called on the MQTT client factory.

methods.name: testSubscribeFails
methods.description: Tests the behavior when subscribing to a topic fails, expecting a failure status message.

methods.name: createClientActor
methods.description: Creates the actor properties for the MQTT client actor with the given connection and proxy actor.

methods.name: createFailingClientActor
methods.description: Creates actor properties for a client that simulates a connection failure.

methods.name: createClientActorWithMessages
methods.description: Creates the MQTT client actor with a set of predefined messages for testing.

methods.name: mqttMessage
methods.description: Constructs an MQTT message with the given topic and payload string.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts payload string from an MQTT message.

methods.name: extractTopic
methods.description: Retrieves the topic string from an MQTT message.

methods.name: getMessageClass
methods.description: Returns the class of the MQTT message used in the tests.
